messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered (P2) — elevated 5xx rate observed from control-plane-facing requests. Affected endpoints: auth verify, org-lookup, billing-lookup. Paging oncall (maya) and shifting to live mitigation channel.

simon: seeing a big bump in 502/504s starting ~2112233400 across multiple regions. Error rate ~12% over the last 5m. External gateway returning: `upstream prematurely closed connection` and `context deadline exceeded`.

maya: on it. quick check — Grafana dashboard shows auth latency tail rising from 120ms -> 2.3s and 95th p50->p95 gap huge. org-lookup timeouts correlate with high tail. Any config changes in last hour?

arjun: rolling logs show a flurry of `rpc: context canceled` from auth-dep. Also seeing increased retries from gateway: `retries exhausted`.

nora_ops: I just got a deploy webhook at 2112233300 for `org-cache-ttl` change. @arjun can you confirm if that aligns? Could be a cache miss storm.

arjun: yep that deploy toggled `org_lookup_cache=on` -> `off` and reduced TTL to 0 for testing. That would increase calls to org service dramatically. Reverting now.

simon: ok revert command I'm running:
```
kubectl -n controlplane set env deployment/controlplane CONFIG_ORG_CACHE_TTL=600
kubectl rollout restart deployment/controlplane
```

maya: also increasing gateway timeout as a short-term lift:
```
kubectl -n gateway patch configmap gateway-config -p '{"data":{"upstream_timeout":"30s"}}'
kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway
```

incident-bot: Action logged: revert org cache TTL + gateway timeout bump. Notifying infra.

arjun: rolling restart of controlplane done. auth logs show reduced error spikes after 30s. org-lookup QPS dropped from 1800 -> 220 per sec.

simon: after revert: 5xx rate down to ~1.1% across the cluster. Not fully back to baseline (0.3%) but much better.

maya: mitigating steps tracked. Next actions: 1) keep TTL=600 for 1hr, 2) monitor p95 auth latency, 3) roll forward alternative canary of org cache with gradual ramp, 4) open post-incident ticket to review deploy gating.

nora_ops: confirming customer impact — our Uptime SLO shows 2.5% error budget consumed in last hour for control-plane calls. No major downstream customer outages reported yet, but some clients saw retries and slow responses.

pagerduty: paging: handing off to night oncall @maya for monitoring and follow-up. Please ack when stable for 30m.

maya: ack. I'll keep a watch for 60m and if numbers hold will close the pager. leaving notes in incident tracker.

simon: doc note for postmortem: avoid zero-ttl cache toggles in prod without ramp, add deploy block if QPS > X. Also add a canary gate for config toggles that affect fanout.

arjun: added a temporary circuit breaker on our org-lookup client to fail fast and reduce cascading retries. Patch:
```
client.Options{MaxRetries:2, Backoff:Exponential(50ms, 500ms), CircuitBreaker: true}
```

maya: thanks all. closing live mitigation thread, keeping incident open for root cause + follow-up. :thumbsup:
